simple.summary: בְּקִיעַ (bᵉqîyaʻ) means a fissure First listed occurrence: Amos 6 11.

definitions.full: H1233. beqia or baqia [ בָּקִיעַ בְּקִיעַ, ] noun [masculine] fissure, breach , Amos 6:11 בְּקִעִים , into which the small house is to be smitten (|| רְסִיסִים ); עִירדָּֿוִד בְּקִיעֵי Isa 22:9 .
